row of repeated similar motifs across the upper zone

justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, schematic low-relief motifs on a broad upright monolithic face, and both include profile bird forms, disc/ring shapes and a row of repeated symmetrical elements across the upper zone, which gives a comparable overall impression. But the specific content diverges: A shows a register-divided scene with quadrupeds, a fringed horizontal band, a snake-like animal and three loop-shaped objects, while B shows paired bird-headed anthropomorphs flanking ring-and-girdle motifs and paddle-like forms with faces, so the actual motif vocabulary and the relationships between figures are not the same.
